Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | National U-15 Boys edge Kazakhstan 2-1 to end Group W with perfect record Source : GFA 26 October 2026 3:07pm Audio By Carbonatix
The National U-15 Boys team ended their Group W campaign with a perfect record after edging Kazakhstan 2-1 in their final group match at the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Azerbaijan.
Goals from Angel Junior Adjei and Shamsudeen Sulemana secured the victory for Ghana, who have now won all five of their group games.
The win completes a flawless group stage for the young lads:
Ghana finishes top of Group W with five wins from five, scoring 27 goals in the process, and will now await their opponents in the next phase of the FIFA U-15 Tournament and Festival.
